title: Tampa and Ybor City Private Photoshoot with Local Photographer
includes: 20 professionally edited photos delivered within 7 business days
Online gallery for downloading your photos
Transportation to and from locations (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We will explore areas around downtown like the scenic waterfront at Tampa Riverwalk, the open space and skyline views at Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, the historic campus of University of Tampa, or the colorful brick streets of Ybor City.

Whether you are traveling solo, with your partner, or with friends and family, this experience is a fun way to capture real moments from your time in Tampa.

Don’t worry if you are not used to being in front of the camera. I will guide you with simple poses and help keep things natural and relaxed.
